semiconductor_relevance: None — Aralyse is focused on photonics and optical metasurface sensors, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Aralyse is a photonics research group that develops advanced optical metasurface sensors for medical diagnostics and environmental monitoring. Their expertise lies in designing and fabricating label-free sensor platforms capable of high-sensitivity detection without complex sample preparation.
capabilities: Label-free sensor platforms for biomolecule detection
In-house fabrication capabilities including PVD and RIE
